# Casa Villa Restaurant

> Casa Villa Restaurant — A Taste of Mexico in Stamford

## Menu
Casa Villa offers a diverse menu of authentic Mexican and Latin American cuisine, featuring traditional breakfast, lunch, and dinner options such as tacos, burritos, fajitas, enchiladas, and fresh seafood, all prepared with fresh ingredients and known for generous portions.
